nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes files and directories (node_modules, .git, logs, local env files, etc.) from the Docker build context for the backend image, keeping builds fast and images lean.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Docker build for the backend Node.js/Express API: installs dependencies, generates the Prisma client at build time, creates a non-root user, exposes port 5000, and starts the app through a migrate-and-start entrypoint script.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs `prisma generate` during the image build so the Prisma client is baked into the image, and delegates startup to a dedicated `scripts/migrate-and-start.sh` entrypoint that runs database migrations before launching the server.
